evidence_payload.evidence: Concrete, source-checkable figures are retained at exec-appropriate grain: 74 glossary terms (line 33) and 8 conceptual-model domains (line 34), both traced in evidence-traceability.md to WP5-Data-Management-Framework-Report.md §2.2/§3.2-3.3. reader_facing_appropriateness.evidence: Grep of the full draft confirms zero `%%` review markers, zero internal node/pillar/requirement codes, and no x.x sitemap sub-labels (§1.4.2 now uses a plain-prose sentence at line 23 describing sub-content by user mission instead of exposing sitemap numbering). The deleted table row's underlying claim (content-readiness assessment) is no longer asserted as a named core component anywhere in the draft, removing the prior source-fidelity risk of overstating it to contract-defined-component status; the surviving qualitative sentence at line 27 stays within the fidelity note's bound (design rationale only, no numeric gap figures).

form_readability.evidence: Required structure present per writing-contract.json required_structures: three subsections (1.4.1/1.4.2/1.4.3), one value table, two figure placeholders (ภาพประกอบที่ 1 at line 25, ภาพประกอบที่ 2 at line 39). altitude.evidence: Content stays at target_altitude throughout: six web-structure areas are each summarized in one line without page/field/requirement-code detail (lines 16-21), sub-content is acknowledged only at the 'divides by user mission' level (line 23) with detail explicitly deferred to the full sitemap, and content-readiness is mentioned only as qualitative design rationale (line 27) with no numeric readiness indicators anywhere in the draft (grep for 16/26/33-style figures returned zero hits).

headline_conclusion.evidence: Opening paragraph states the headline conclusion up front -- a blueprint built to inform future system requirements, not an operating platform (line 3, 'ให้เป็นแบบพิมพ์เขียว...โดยมีจุดประสงค์ในการใช้จัดทำข้อกำหนดให้ผู้พัฒนาระบบในระยะถัดไป'). findings_over_process.evidence: The draft reports what was built and what it means for the department (findings: components, value, conditions) rather than narrating the consulting method. References to 'คณะที่ปรึกษา' (lines 3, 14, 27, 31) attribute authorship of a stated result in a single clause each and are not followed by process narration -- consistent with the house style of naming the consultant as the actor of a finished analysis/design, not describing how the work was done.

findings.location: 1.4.2, sub-content sentence (line 23) and figure caption area (formerly after line 21)
findings.issue: Round 1 finding: an unresolved review marker ('%%please include sub topics x.x. level%%') sat in the draft asking for sitemap x.x sub-labels to be added under §1.4.2, which would have pulled node-level sitemap codes into an executive-altitude section.

findings.location: Value table, row 4 (formerly after the 'กลไกการกำกับดูแลและอนุมัติ' row, now removed)
findings.issue: Round 2 finding: the table still carried a fourth row -- 'ผลประเมินความพร้อมของเนื้อหา | เห็นชัดว่าบริการใดมีข้อมูลรองรับแล้วหรือยังมีข้อจำกัด | จัดลำดับงานพัฒนาเนื้อหาและระบบได้ตามหลักฐาน' -- which promoted content-readiness assessment to a 4th core component the contract does not name, and duplicated the qualitative design-rationale paragraph that already discharged the plan's allowance to mention readiness only as design justification.
findings.disposition: Resolved: the row has been deleted. The qualitative paragraph at line 27 remains and reads fine standalone, correctly discharging the readiness-as-design-rationale allowance without re-promoting it to a table-level component or reintroducing numeric gap figures.
